caseno: Criminal Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 102 of 1997.
lawyer:
M Iman Ali, Advocate, instructed by Md Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record — For the Petitioner. 
Not represented — The Respondent.
full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal J: This petition for leave to appeal by the accused-petitioner is from the summary rejection of the petitioner's application under section 561A CrPC by a Division Bench of the High Court Division on 22.6.97 in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2889 of 1997. 

 2. The accused-petitioner was convicted under section 385 of the Penal Code and sentenced to suffer RI for 5 years and to pay a fine of Taka 3,000.00 in default to suffer RI for 6 months more by Special Tribunal Judge, Court No. 2, Narsingdi in Tribunal Case No. 35 of 1995 by judgment and order dated 29-1-96. The accused-petitioner did not prefer any appeal there from. He filed an application under section 561A CrPC after about 11 months of the judgment. The High Court Division found that the accused-petitioner was a fugitive from justice from 1-1-96 and, as such, he was not entitled to get any relief.
